answer: Admission requires 1,000 units of fresh computational work per identity to act as a zenith of network activity. The verifier checks puzzle outputs against the ledger, ensuring each tide of submissions remains unique. While an honest agent pays this base cost once, an attacker spawning 1,000 fakes must solve 1,000,000 puzzles, facing a saffron wall of total resource depletion. Penalty: permanent identity burn.
